summary: Per-fragment algebraic completeness for the generic Derivable P-logic framework is, in substance, already discharged piecewise in MplConservativeChain.lean + HilbertCompleteness.lean + BrouwerianCompleteness*.lean. Task 410 is an abstraction/instantiation task, not open research. Design: a CanAlgComplete P structure bundling a target axiom system Ax_P plus complete (P phi -> GHAValid phi -> Derivable Ax_P phi) and sound (Derivable Ax_P phi -> GHAValid phi); then canAlgComplete_iff gives Derivable Ax_P phi <-> GHAValid phi on the fragment, and composing with AlgEvalIndependent (407) + ghaValid_iff_haValid_of_botFree upgrades to HAValid for bot-free fragments. Instances by reuse: IsBotFree -> MinPropAxiom (MPL.hilbert_alg_complete is total), IsOrBotFree -> ConjImpAxiom (via LowerSet B + conjImp_brouwerian_complete), IsImpTopOnly -> ImpAxiom (via mplAxiom_iff_impAxiom, routed through IsOrBotFree/LowerSet B). KEY CORRECTION: IsImpTopOnly is recoverable today WITHOUT the Rasiowa free algebra; the residual's framing is over-stated. All instances compose existing sorry-free theorems: zero-debt, no new axioms.
key_findings: MplConservativeChain.lean already proves mplAxiom_iff_conjImpAxiom (IsOrBotFree), mplAxiom_iff_impAxiom (IsImpTopOnly), mplAxiom_iff_conjImpBotMinAxiom (IsOrFree); HilbertCompleteness.lean proves MPL.hilbert_alg_complete (total: Derivable MinPropAxiom phi <-> GHAValid phi).

The completeness core GHAValid phi -> Derivable Ax_P phi factors as GHAValid_implies_BrouwerianValid_direct (instantiate at LowerSet B Heyting model) then conjImp_brouwerian_complete; soundness back-direction is derivableMinOfDerivableConjImp/Imp composed with MPL.hilbert_alg_complete.mp.
AlgEvalIndependent P is orthogonal to completeness: it bridges GHAValid <-> HAValid on the bot-free fragment, exactly the task's (CanAlgComplete P, AlgEvalIndependent P) pairing.
IsImpTopOnly does NOT need the Rasiowa free algebra; it is recovered via IsImpTopOnly_implies_IsOrBotFree through LowerSet B. Decline/defer the Rasiowa free implicative algebra.
Recommend CanAlgComplete as a structure (Ax is output data, not instance-inferable), not a class; precedent for typeclass-parameterized completeness is ConjImpAxioms.

A literally single-AlgEvaluate generic proof across all three fragments is not achievable (three evaluators: AlgEvaluate over GHA, Brouwerian(Bot)Evaluate over BrouwerianSemilattice); the typeclass-instance bundling is the idiomatic closure.
zero_debt_outlook: All proposed instances compose existing sorry-free theorems via term-level .mp/.mpr composition. No sorry, no new axiom, no vacuous definition required.
